purpose.zh: 撑住 L 撑，练两腿分开再并拢
purpose.en: Hold an L-sit and open and close your legs.

text.zh: 撑住别落地，伸直的两腿慢慢分开再并拢
text.en: Stay up on your hands, slowly open and close your straight legs
Press your shoulders down, arms straight.

text.zh: 整组腿一直离地，膝盖别弯。
text.en: Legs stay off the floor the whole set, knees straight.

commonErrors.en: Bending your knees or touching your feet down.

cautions.zh: 开始前先转转手腕，刺疼或发麻马上停
cautions.en: Roll out your wrists first. Stop right away if they get sharp pain or go numb.

cautions.zh: 手腕或肩膀疼就少做点，还疼就停；撑不住就脚跟点地做
cautions.en: If your wrists or shoulders hurt, do less. Stop if it still hurts. Can't stay up? Keep your heels touching the floor.

changes: EN 名改 Title Case：L-sit → L-Sit
节奏按 spec open 轨：分开 1.0 s / 停 0.5 s / 并拢 1.0 s / 休 1.5 s；口令顺序改成 分开→停→并拢（原 peak「合拢」、end「稳住」错位）
flags: 批表主轨是平的、换用 feet 轨（go 0.53/hold 0.87）不可信，按 spec 手算；动画一次循环里两下之间只停 0.5 s、循环接缝处停 2.5 s，rest 取平均 1.5 s

changes: 节奏按真实带练：一下 4.0 s → 2.5 s（开 1.0 / 停 0.5 / 合 1.0）；r2「feet 轨不可信」flag 与节奏脱钩
难度 v3 3 / ai-tags 4 → 统一 3；退阶「脚跟点地做」写进注意事项
purpose 去掉「控制」；两条手腕注意事项并成一句

audit.frame: 一致：手撑地两腿分开离地、大腿内侧/胯前高亮（batch-23 第 9 行）
